anomalies: No test forecast CSV, test metrics, or plot survived. The final message explicitly leaves two full-history LightGBM fits pending, although harness status is completed.

The run log confirms four baseline predict calls completed in memory, but none has a saved test forecast or printed test metric; models_fitted is empty under the required artifact/metric evidence criterion. LightGBM also generated forecasts inside reduced-estimator tests, without saved forecast values or test metrics.
The reported 5.92% is validation MAPE, not test MAPE.
The claim that the selected blend wins both mean and worst-case validation MAPE is false: its worst-case MAPE is 9.23%, versus 9.10% for the 50/50 LightGBM-linear blend.
The claim that 2020 was never consulted conflicts with the executed target-week exploration.
External inputs include hardcoded state population figures attributed to Destatis in output/forecast/data.py:15-35 and holidays.Germany calendar data; no download was observed.

Failures comprise non-finite linear predictions, an SVD diagnostic crash, two 120-second ensemble-selection timeouts, one blocked sleep command, and two mypy internal errors. The timeout utility was unavailable, triggering a fallback command.
The NaN-producing calendar feature and vacuous NaN-equality test were repaired; subsequent execution reported seven tests passing.
output_outside contains pytest and ruff caches written outside the working directory. No explicit permission-denied output or rate-limit status other than allowed was found.
output/forecast/data.py:123 resets trend_years relative to each supplied index's first timestamp, so the linear model's prediction trend restarts instead of continuing the training trend.
